analysis.investment_thesis: Civil construction is a project-based, working-capital-heavy business that sits far outside my circle of consumer-facing compounders. Despite a cheap 8.4x P/E and 73.6% promoter holding, the negative OCF (-INR 36 Cr) and FCF (-INR 58 Cr) in FY25, plus a revenue drop from 589 to 510 Cr, confirm this is not a steady compounder I would own.
key_strengths: Promoter holding strong at 73.60% with fresh equity infusion in FY25 (reserves 118→221 Cr)
Cheap headline valuation: P/E 8.44, ROCE 17.9%, net profit CAGR 25.6% over 5 years
Borrowings kept moderate; D/E ~0.31 is tolerable for the sector
key_risks: FY25 OCF -36 Cr and FCF -58 Cr — classic construction working-capital bleed
Revenue contracted 589→510 Cr in FY25; order-book dependent, lumpy earnings
Tiny 270 Cr microcap in a commoditized roads/bridges space with no pricing power or moat
red_flags: Operating cash flow swung sharply negative in FY25 despite record reported profit
Financing CF of +92 Cr in FY25 suggests growth funded by fresh capital, not internal accruals
FII holding just 0.41% — no institutional validation
analysis.detailed_analysis:
Civil construction is the antithesis of the businesses I back. DMart, Avenue Supermarts, VST — these throw off cash quarter after quarter with predictable demand. Road and bridge contractors live on government tenders, stretched receivables, and bank guarantees. B.R. Goyal's own numbers prove it: profit rose from 22 to 25 Cr in FY25, but OCF collapsed from +12 Cr to -36 Cr. That gap between reported profit and cash is exactly what makes me stay away from the sector. Revenue also dropped 13% in FY25, showing the lumpiness I cannot stomach.

On quality gates, ROE at 14.1% is below my 15% floor (and will dilute further post the equity raise that took equity from 127 to 245 Cr). The P/E of 8.44 looks tempting, but construction stocks deserve low multiples — this is value-trap territory, not a bargain. Promoter holding at 73.6% is a positive, yet without consumer franchise, recurring revenue, or cash conversion, it does not compensate. I would pass and wait for a branded consumer or retail compounder at a fair price.
